record.original_question: Can one construct the moduli space Delta_G for a characteristic-zero local field such as Q_p?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.2. Construct the moduli space ∆G for a local field of characteristic zero such as Qp .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite group. For a perfect field $k$ of positive characteristic (with $|G|$ allowed to be divisible by $\operatorname{char} k$), one can form a moduli space (more precisely, a formal stack or ind-scheme) $\Delta_G$ over $k$ whose $B$-points, for a $k$-algebra $B$, parametrize $G$-torsors over $\operatorname{Spec} B(\!(t)\!)$ (equivalently, continuous homomorphisms from the absolute Galois group of $B(\!(t)\!)$ to $G$, up to conjugation). This moduli space plays a central role in the wild McKay correspondence, where motivic integrals over $\Delta_G$ compute stringy invariants of quotient varieties $V/G$.
 
Problem: Construct an analogous moduli space $\Delta_G$ associated to a local field of characteristic zero, such as $\mathbb{Q}_p$, that parametrizes $G$-torsors over (families of) such local fields and that is suitable for developing a motivic integration theory and a wild McKay correspondence in mixed characteristic. Specifically, define a geometric object $\Delta_G$ over an appropriate base (e.g.\ $\operatorname{Spf} \mathbb{Z}_p$ or $\operatorname{Spec} \mathbb{F}_p$) whose points classify $G$-torsors over $p$-adic local fields, establish its basic geometric properties (such as a stratification by ramification data, dimension, and a measure), and show that integration on $\Delta_G$ recovers the expected invariants of quotients in mixed characteristic.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of G-torsors and wild McKay correspondence
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a collection of open problems on the wild McKay correspondence (T. Yasuda). The construction of $\Delta_G$ exists for equal-characteristic local fields (via the "moduli of formal torsors" framework), but no construction over mixed-characteristic local fields such as $\mathbb{Q}_p$ appears in the literature; recent related work on $G$-torsors over perfectoid/adic spaces over $\mathbb{Q}_p$ does not provide such a moduli object suitable for motivic integration. No resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of formal torsors II
status_evidence.snippet: Defines and studies the moduli space Δ_G of G-torsors over Spec B((t)) in positive/equal characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: The moduli space Δ_G is constructed only in the equal-characteristic setting.

status_evidence.title: G-torsors on perfectoid spaces (arXiv:2207.07623)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies G-torsors on adic spaces over Q_p in the v-topology.
status_evidence.claim: Related mixed-characteristic work on G-torsors exists but does not construct the desired moduli Δ_G for motivic-integration purposes.
